_comment: Our own patches on top of the vendored (GPLv3, lib/wappalyzer_data/) Wappalyzer fingerprints, for real, verified gaps in the upstream data — not a general free-for-all signature list. Each entry adds extra header/cookie/meta/html/scriptSrc patterns to an existing technology by name; it never replaces or removes anything from the original fingerprint. This file itself is ours, under this project's MIT license.

Next.js._why: Upstream only checks the X-Powered-By: Next.js header, an old (Pages-Router-era) asset-path HTML pattern that doesn't match modern App Router output, a NEXT_LOCALE cookie that's only set when i18n routing is in use, and __NEXT_DATA__/next.version as *runtime JS* checks this detector can't evaluate (no browser — see CLAUDE.md). Every Next.js app, Pages or App Router, always serves its bundled JS/CSS from a hardcoded /_next/static/ path regardless of any of that, so it's a reliable static-HTML signal upstream is simply missing a scriptSrc pattern for. Verified on two real sites: zakazbuketov.kz (has neither X-Powered-By nor the HTML pattern, but does have the x-nextjs-* headers below) and egov.kz (has none of the above — no X-Powered-By, no NEXT_LOCALE cookie, no x-nextjs-* headers — but every asset is served from /_next/static/).
